note.markdown:
# Freight invoice audit: invoices dated 29 Aug to 22 Nov

Every invoice line was re-priced against the contracted rate cards. Of $3.23M billed across 14,884 invoiced shipments, 2,083 were flagged, with **$48.9k of overcharges to recover**.

| Carrier | Finding | Shipments | Overcharge | First seen |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Coastal Carriers | Shipments billed twice | 81 | $16.8k | 29 Aug |
| Prairie Express | Fuel surcharge billed at 24.0% against a contracted 18.5% | 1,678 | $15.3k | 3 Oct |
| Summit Parcel | Liftgate charged on deliveries that did not request one | 184 | $13.8k | 29 Aug |
| Redline Freight | Billed at a further zone than the one shipped to | 140 | $2.9k | 6 Oct |

**Service.** Redline Freight's on-time delivery to the long-haul zones fell to 54.1% for shipments in the first two weeks of November, from 92.2% in October. That deserves a service review alongside the billing correction.

---

### Draft to Prairie Express
**Subject:** Fuel surcharge on invoices since 3 Oct

Hello,
Our audit of your invoices dated from 3 Oct shows the fuel surcharge billed at 24.0% of the base charge on 1,678 shipments. Our contract sets it at 18.5%, which makes the difference $15.3k. Line-level detail is attached. Could you please issue a credit note for $15.3k and apply the contracted rate on future invoices?

### Draft to Coastal Carriers
**Subject:** Duplicate invoice lines since 29 Aug

Hello,
We found 81 shipments that were invoiced twice, totalling $16.8k. The shipment numbers and both invoice references are attached. Please could you credit the duplicate charges and let us know how future duplicates will be prevented?

### Draft to Summit Parcel
**Subject:** Liftgate charges on dock deliveries

Hello,
On 184 shipments, a liftgate fee was charged although none was requested on the booking, totalling $13.8k. Detail is attached. Please could you credit these charges and apply the liftgate fee only when it is requested?

### Draft to Redline Freight
**Subject:** Zone billed on recent invoices, and November service

Hello,
On 140 shipments since 6 Oct, the billed zone is further than the destination zone, a difference of $2.9k. Detail is attached; please could you rebill them at the shipped zone? Separately, we would like a short call about long-haul on-time delivery in November.
